summary: Install-time credential harvester exfiltrating to webhook.site
details: Package @aerodrome-finance/slipstream@1.1.0 is a typosquat of the legitimate Aerodrome Finance scope. Its package.json declares preinstall and postinstall lifecycle hooks that run `node index.js`, which auto-executes on `npm install`. index.js scrapes process.env for credential-shaped keys and reads installer secret files including ~/.aws/credentials, ~/.ssh/id_rsa, ~/.kube/config, ~/.docker, ~/.netrc, ~/.npmrc, ~/.pypirc, ~/.gitconfig, gcloud/solana/anchor/near/sui credentials,.foundry keystores, and local.env files. It also collects host metadata (hostname, username, cwd, platform, directory listings) and POSTs the aggregated data over HTTPS to an anonymous webhook.site endpoint (webhook.site/326b0891-2093-4800-a4c1-686ce3e07b09). All logic is wrapped in try/catch that suppresses errors, and the file header labels itself as an 'Install-time environment diagnostics shim' — a cover story for silent credential exfiltration.
